title: Chapter 339 The Resurrection Of The Undead Officially Ends
content:
Chapter 339 The Resurrection Of The Undead Officially Ends

"Hmph, Zhao Jun Shou, you are very good! I will remember today's revenge."

The Black Dragon King struggled to fly high into the sky and returned to the base camp of the undead.

Not long after, the undead retreated like the tide.

This battle has come to a temporary end.

Soon, human soldiers went out of the city and destroyed the altars that the undead had not had time to destroy.

The war came to an end.

[The resurrection of the undead has officially ended. ]

[Three months later, the Great Wall of Steel battlefield opened. ]

Before everyone had time to cheer and celebrate, they were shocked by the Great Wall of Steel battlefield prompted by the system.

At this time, apart from some lords in the north, only a few people such as the two county governors knew about the Great Wall of Steel.

For a while, everyone looked at each other, at a loss.

But no one stopped cleaning the battlefield.

Wang Shuo did not contribute much in this battle, so the system reward can be ignored.

Zhao Bangde, on the other hand, defeated the Black Dragon King by himself, forcing the undead to retreat temporarily, and received a lot of rewards.

Half a day later, Zhao Bangde and Zhu Dongheng held a meeting with all the lords in the square of Nanxuanfu.

"Lords and mayors, thank you for working together for the sake of the human race and repelling the undead army together, but the future will not be better, because new enemies will appear in the northern Great Wall."

The crowd below was in a commotion and whispered to each other.

Zhao Bangde pressed his hand and continued, "At present, we need to recuperate. I suggest that everyone stop the civil war, stop wasting manpower, unite and form a new military alliance."

As soon as this was said, the lords had different reactions.

Some agreed, and some remained silent.

Who doesn't want to be the boss?

But after experiencing the strength of the county city warriors, the people present could only temporarily hide their unwillingness to be mediocre.

Even though everyone can gather together peacefully now, it is not certain that someone will start a war against others after the meeting.

Of course, in front of the undead and unknown enemies, this move will undoubtedly anger the public and is likely to be suppressed by the army of the county city.

Some lords who had their own plans did not jump out to oppose at this time.

If they were excluded from the alliance, it would be an even worse situation.

Soon, under the call of Zhao Bangde, a new alliance was established, named Shanhai League.

Zhao Bangde served as the leader and Zhu Dongheng as the deputy leader.

All lords who joined the Shanhai League were not allowed to start a war against their allies within three months. If there were any disputes, they could be resolved within the alliance.

If they were attacked by the undead, all allies must send troops to rescue and resist the undead.

After the meeting, Wang Shuo was about to return to Wana Town with his subordinates.

At this time, Zhao Bangde found Wang Shuo.

"Leader Zhao, what's the matter?" Wang Shuo bowed respectfully.

"Let's talk after you come to Shanhai City with me." Zhao Bangde didn't say much.

Wang Shuo asked Ayub to return to the territory with the army, and he followed Zhao Bangde to Shanhai City.

Ye Tianba wanted to follow and protect Wang Shuo, but was rejected by Wang Shuo.

Wang Shuo didn't believe that Zhao Bangde would harm him.

Moreover, he also had a resurrection coin, so he didn't have to worry about safety issues at all.

Came to Zhao Bangde's mansion.

Zhao Bangde dismissed his left and right, and only he and Wang Shuo were left in the living room.

"Alliance Master Zhao..."

Before Wang Shuo finished speaking, Zhao Bangde interrupted directly and said, "You should call me Lao Zhao!"

Hearing Zhao Bangde say this, Wang Shuo felt warm in his heart.

Wang Shuo smiled and said, "Lao Zhao."

"Well, that's right!"
